title: Recent advances in osteoarthritis imaging--the osteoarthritis initiative

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Recent advances in osteoarthritis imaging--the osteoarthritis initiative》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The osteoarthritis initiative (OAI) is a multicentre, longitudinal, prospective observational cohort study of knee OA that aims to provide publicly accessible clinical datasets, images and biospecimens, to enable researchers to investigate factors that influence the onset and development of OA, and evaluate biomarkers that predict and track the course of the disease.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】In this Perspectives, we describe the rationale and design of the OAI and its cohort, discuss imaging protocols and summarize image analyses completed to date.

In this Perspectives, we describe the rationale and design of the OAI and its cohort, discuss imaging protocols and summarize image analyses completed to date.
